title: PulsePayEventMetadata
description: Common metadata envelope for PulsePay domain events.

eventVersion.description: Monotonically increasing integer. Version 1 = initial schema. Consumers must check this field and reject or route to a dead-letter queue any version they have not been coded to handle. See CHANGELOG.md in this directory for the version-to-field mapping per event type.

schemaId.description: Schema Registry subject + version reference, e.g. payment-created-value:3. Populated automatically by the kafka-lib producer base class. Consumers can use this to retrieve the exact schema from the registry.

environment.description: Runtime environment that produced this event. Prevents cross-environment event leakage in shared Kafka clusters.

occurredAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp for when the event occurred.

traceId.description: Distributed tracing identifier propagated across services.
